background: National Westminster Bank is the main ring-fenced bank of NatWest Group, funded by UK personal and business deposits and lending on residential mortgages and to UK companies, where it is the largest business lender.
synthesis: The bank is rated AA- on average across all three main agencies, the weakest of them at A+, all three on a stable outlook, with the last move a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 12 May 2026. Capital is the weak side against UK majors: CET1 of 11.2% and leverage of 4.4% are both in the bottom quarter, the thinnest capital of the UK ring-fenced banks held here. Liquidity is mixed, with LCR of 140% below the peer median and NSFR of 132% at the median, and LCR has fallen 10 points since 30 Jun 2025 while the rest has been flat. The flagged news is all good, with half-year profit up 20% reported on 31 Jul 2026, and the ratings say group support matters more than the entity's own ratios.
